lead: Paying for the widening of McCall Blvd in Menifee from four to six lanes, tied to its Menifee Valley development; on Oct 7, 2026 the city council approved eminent domain on parts of seven vacant parcels to get the land.
notes: Source: Menifee 24/7, Oct 2026 (Menifee City Council unanimous vote). Brookfield covers all costs including construction. Construction schedule and contractor not yet public; ask Brookfield's Menifee Valley team who will do the grading and paving, and pitch dumping for old pavement and curb plus base for the new lanes. Related to Minor Ranch, LLC (Menifee Valley landowner) in yesterday's briefing.
